protocol_clarifications.title: Distinguish canonical Java exclusions from exact closed exported product inventory
protocol_clarifications.issue: Canonical input currently checks required Java paths without closing app/src, and includes an intentionally unexported AdapterInstrumentation.java probe. Reusing exact exported eighteen-name closure blindly would reject legitimate canonical input; retaining open Java input does not fulfill the promised unknown-sibling refusal.
options: Narrow contract to required-source projection at input and closed inventory only after export; explicitly allow excluded siblings at input
Require explicit canonical eighteen-product set plus named excluded probe, refuse unknown Java siblings, and keep exported eighteen-product set exact
